title: Division Precision Problem in Graph Mode on Intel CPU
text: Issue type Bug Have you reproduced the bug with TensorFlow Nightly? Yes Source binary TensorFlow version 2.9 Custom code Yes OS platform and distribution Linux Debian 11 Mobile device _No response_ Python version 3.9 Bazel version _No response_ GCC/compiler version _No response_ CUDA/cuDNN version _No response_ GPU model and memory _No response_ Current behavior?
